timing: Use synthesis-control CSV onset/offset/note_length in 250 Hz frames. Preserve repeated attacks; reject noninteger, reversed, overlapping monophonic or escaping waveform clocks. Preserve a conservative 1-second synthesis/reverb decay support tail without claiming exact key releases.
pitch: pitch_correction_amount is a coefficient correcting mean Hz deviation toward the nominal MIDI frequency; it is not a semitone transposition. It must not be added to CSV pitches. Synthesized intonation/vibrato is not exact acoustic pitch ground truth.
numbering: Upstream postprocess_utils.py uses one-based stem audio/MIDI filenames and zero-based note-expression CSVs, unlike the illustrative format document. Observe actual retained identities, not assumed matching basenames.
